QuestInfo.2: After completing the training to catch Junior Balrogs in #m910500000#, I acquired the Bowman's ultimate skill! Power is now mine--I shall master this skill and use it triumph over my enemies in battle!

0.0: Are you ready? Go to the training field of a different world and hunt #b300 #o9300085##k. After you're trained, you will become stronger! This is necessary preparation to use the skill properly!

yes.0: After this training, I'll teach you the ultimate skill. By the time you finish training, you'll be ready to learn the skill... Ah. It's dangerous to go by yourself so I recommend that you make a #bparty with a 4th Job Bowman.#k When you get ready, let me know!

1.0: Finally, you came back! You look tired but I feel your power from here! Now, you are strong enough to learn the skill!

yes.0: I hope you train yourself and practice with the skill I taught you.

mob.0: Get 300#b#o9300085##k and come back. You're so close--you can do it!
